notes: API-07 is a pure input validation module. All 36 test cases pass with 0 leaks after the arena allocator fix in step-02a. No regressions in the full test suite (246 pass, 0 fail, 102 skip). The benchmark suite is a known stub and does not block this release as input validation has no I/O or database performance characteristics of its own. NFR validation will be performed at the infrastructure/stage level.
